result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the prior project-shell refresh ambiguity finding. Re-checked the new project refresh-target-count contract, the project shell reader/UI gating, the touched refresh runtime, the focused client/server tests, and reran the story and epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Project source summaries now expose `projectRefreshTargetCount`, `SourceSectionReader` computes that count from current process material refs, and the project-shell UI only renders refresh/hydrate controls for process-scoped sources or project-scoped sources with exactly one current target. Focused UI tests cover zero/one/many target cases, focused bootstrap API tests verify the summary metadata contract, and the story/epic gates both pass.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/client/source-management-ui.test.ts tests/service/server/project-shell-bootstrap-api.test.ts --environment node

additionalObservations: The touched production path no longer presents the false project-shell recovery affordance from the prior verifier finding: ambiguous project-scoped rows keep their hydration/freshness visibility but do not offer refresh until ownership is unambiguous.
No new fake adapter, shim, or placeholder behavior was found in the touched refresh/runtime path during this follow-up review.
